# Copilot instructions

Keep the repository documentation and diagrams in sync with every change.

Any modification to source code, deployment scripts, environment behavior, security flow, identity flow, Cloudflare configuration, or runtime topology must also update the relevant documentation under [docs/](../docs/) and diagrams under [diagrams/](../diagrams/).

Do not finish a task while documentation is stale. If the implementation changes, update the matching architecture notes, deployment notes, security notes, and Mermaid diagrams in the same work.

This repo treats documentation as part of the product change set, not as optional follow-up work.
